name: adafruit-metro-s3
title: Adafruit Metro ESP32-S3
notes: ESP32-S3 with 16 MB flash and 8 MB octal PSRAM. Pins: Adafruit Metro ESP32-S3 pinouts (microSD on SPI: SCK 39, MOSI 42, MISO 21, CS 45), arduino-esp32 adafruit_metro_esp32s3 variant (red LED 13). Wi-Fi only: Arduino W5500 shields use D11-D13, which are plain GPIOs here, not the SPI bus the card is on.
